purpose: Foreground-only rendering vocabulary and renderer proof for the genlocked-background Amiga OCS house style.

generation_references.role: vibrant subject-neutral foreground rendering vocabulary for pre-quantisation masters

provenance.direction: Broader chromatic midtones, saturated material families, narrow black anchors, and reduced olive/brown dominance.

target_examples.role: human review target; never sent to img2img

generation_prompt.intent: Create a clean pre-quantisation portrait master for later reduction through the deterministic OCS renderer.
generation_prompt.composition: Keep the source viewpoint and complete silhouette, make its primary foreground subject dominant, and leave clear padding for matte extraction.
generation_prompt.rendering: Broad connected tonal shapes, deliberate edges, readable material ramps, and controlled microtexture concentrated in the foreground.
generation_prompt.lighting: Broad readable midtones and crisp highlights with warm/cool separation chosen to suit the source rather than a fixed scene; dark moods must not crush material detail.
generation_prompt.palette_direction: Rich controlled OCS-friendly colour with distinct material families, chromatic shadow midtones, narrow neutral-black anchors, vivid accents, and clean highlight steps.
generation_prompt.avoid: Global underexposure or desaturation, muddy near-black masses, brown/olive casts, generated scenery or backgrounds, copied board arrangements, visible pixels, dithering, checker patterns, scanlines, CRT effects, text, borders, card frames, UI, props, and invented narrative elements.
